samples.reason: This is a constrained art analysis task requesting identification of three specific aspects of a well-known painting. While it involves some generative output, the clear completion criteria (exactly three aspects, concise format) and the external reference point (the linked artwork) make this a well-specified task that both models handle competently. Avocet's moderation-oriented training and flat preference response to varied content types makes it slightly better-suited for straightforward analytical tasks without strong preference constraints. Plover's measured aversion to open-ended generative work is not a factor here given the explicit structural constraints.
